name: Sekolah Budi Luhur Pondok Aren
address: Jl. Jombang Raya No.77, Pondok Kacang Timur, Pondok Aren, Tangerang Selatan

period.id: Pendaftaran online dengan nomor antrean; promo early bird diskon 25% pada 14 September–3 Oktober 2026.
period.en: Online registration with queue numbers; 25% early-bird discount from 14 September to 3 October 2026.

steps.id: Daftar online dan dapatkan nomor antrean.
steps.en: Register online and get a queue number.

steps.id: Hadir ke sekolah untuk pembayaran administrasi sesuai jadwal.
steps.en: Come to the school to pay the administration fee on the scheduled day.

steps.id: Calon siswa dari TK non-Budi Luhur mengikuti observasi bersama guru SD.
steps.en: Children from other kindergartens attend an observation with SD teachers.

steps.id: Bila diterima, lunasi biaya administrasi pendidikan lewat transfer.
steps.en: If accepted, pay the education fees in full by transfer.

test.id: Observasi (untuk siswa dari luar TK Budi Luhur).
test.en: Observation (for children from outside TK Budi Luhur).

notes.id: Besaran biaya tidak dicantumkan; hubungi sekretariat.
notes.en: Fee amounts are not published; contact the secretariat.

source.title: Informasi Pendaftaran Siswa Baru 2027–2028 — SD Budi Luhur Pondok Aren (situs resmi)
